text:
nina: Quick design sync 9: considering a leftrail regrouping: collapse Models + Datasets into a single compact parent but keep explicit breadcrumb context above the canvas. Mock: https://staging.redwood/design/rail-regroup-v2.png

eli: +1 for density, but curious about first-time discovery. Can we add a one-time inline hint or a lightweight banner that links to a tour? Suggest query param `?tour=assets`.

sam: Router concerns: must preserve old permalinks. Plan: server 301s for legacy `/models/:id` and `/datasets/:id` -> canonical `/console/w/:org/models/:id` (or `/datasets/:id`). Also support client-side alias `/assets/models/:id` that maps to canonical route so UI shows compact group. Keep UI state in querystring for reproducible deep links.

rachel: A11y checklist: the group toggle needs `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, and an `aria-live` announcer for state changes (e.g., "Assets expanded"). Keyboard nav: header tabbable, toggle with Enter/Space, arrow-key traversal for children. When expanding programmatically on route load, do NOT steal focus.

nina: Copy discussion: 'Assets' vs 'Data & Models' vs 'Catalog'. Leaning 'Assets' visually with tooltip text "Models & Datasets" exposed on hover and focus. We'll A/B test.

ui-bot: preview: https://staging-console.redwood/preview/rail-regroup (build 5267) :rocket:

eli: Banner copy suggestion: "Models are now under Assets 9 View layout or take a guided tour." CTAs: "Show me" / "Take tour". Track CTA CTR and search fallback usage.

sam: I'll add route aliases + shortlink rewrites (e.g., `/m/:id` -> `/console/w/:org/models/:id`) and persist split view state in querystring. Will PR today.

rachel: I'll add acceptance criteria for screen readers and keyboard-only flows, and confirm live-region messages are debounced to avoid repetition.

nina: Target: alpha on staging next Tuesday. Flag blockers now. Thanks! :thumbsup:
